Body.Content: The Mobile Services .NET backend is generally available. With a .NET backend, you can write your services using the power of ASP.NET Web API and your favorite .NET language. Mobile Services lets you add a cloud-hosted backend to your mobile app and quickly light up functionality such as data storage, authentication, and scalable push notifications. For more information, check out the announcement blog post from Scott Guthrie.
Body.Markdown:
The Mobile Services .NET backend is generally available. With a .NET backend, you can write your services using the power of ASP.NET Web API and your favorite .NET language. Mobile Services lets you add a cloud-hosted backend to your mobile app and quickly light up functionality such as data storage, authentication, and scalable push notifications.

For more information, check out the announcement blog post from Scott Guthrie .
